scope: Read-only analysis of existing source and fix3q candidate image; no current-board assertions.

findings.claim: Source and extracted fix3q init acquire z1diag; boot-completed pm_guard acquires it again. Configured policy is verified, execution/active state on board unknown.

CONFIG_SUSPEND=y and CONFIG_PM_WAKELOCKS=y, CONFIG_PM_AUTOSLEEP=n. Android9 libsuspend reads/writes wakeup_count then writes mem; kernel autosleep disabled does not disable this route. Direct state writes alone do not implement wakeup_count handshake.

pm_states_init always advertises mem and freeze under suspend; mem_sleep initially s2idle, deep requires valid platform suspend ops. No suspend_set_ops/platform_suspend_ops/cpu_suspend match in local arch/arm/mach-mediatek. This limited source search is not proof running kernel lacks deep suspend; need same-boot mem_sleep.

MT6323 compatible maps to rtc-mt6397; read_alarm/set_alarm exist, wakeup enabled in probe, suspend calls enable_irq_wake but ignores return. RTC node or enabled wake policy does not verify IRQ delivery or resume.

findings.topic: PMIC fallback can hide broken parent IRQ
findings.claim: mt6397_irq_init returns0 on parent IRQ request failure, keeps irq_domain and permits MFD children but skips PM notifier registration. Existing RTC/input nodes therefore cannot prove parent wake path. Storm guard masks parent after64 empty entries. Current board occurrence unverified.

mt6323.dtsi power child has Linux116 and wakeup-source; key driver reports EV_KEY and sync and enables IRQ wake on suspend. AOSP Generic.kl maps116 POWER. Guard comment saying no wakeup-capable keys is stale versus this source. Actual selected InputReader layout, press/release event delivery and wake are unverified.

Packed watchdogd10 30 means interval10 plus margin30 -> requested40 seconds, not timeout10. Local WDT_MAX_TIMEOUT31 is used for max_hw_heartbeat_ms; set_timeout stores requested value and shifts it without clamp. Core timeout validation does not cap by max_hw_heartbeat_ms; hardware behavior for40 must not be guessed. Suspend stops active watchdog; resume starts and pings. Source callbacks do not prove bound driver or board behavior. Safety worker skips active watchdog and is not a substitute for suspend handling.
CONFIG_WATCHDOG_SYSFS=n; missing class attributes must remain UNKNOWN, not no-watchdog. Never open watchdog character node as a readiness check.

wakeup_count_show calls pm_get_wakeup_count(block=true); it waits for ongoing wake events to complete. Inspector deliberately never reads that path, works only with copied local regular files, and FIFO at that name does not block tests.
